localRemoval: This does not delete a rule from a device.
originalBytes: Original imported bytes; not regenerated from edits.
historyHint: An accepted queue request does not confirm that the device applied a change.
unknownHint: The outcome is uncertain. Check the device response before considering another write; do not replay it.
name: Rule name
expressionHint: Expression text with numeric parameter references.
invalidNumber: Check the range shown below this field.
noCondition: Add a condition to build the rule.
targetChanged: The truck or its device in Karma could not be loaded. Refresh the truck.
fleetUnavailable: Fleet device settings are unavailable in this installation.
ruleIdHint: Choose the device rule ID explicitly (0–65535). Using an existing ID replaces that rule.
localDraftHint: Drafts and names stay in this browser for this account and truck. Saving or importing a draft does not contact the device.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Current drafts remain in memory; export them before leaving.
importHint: Imported command files are inspected only. No commands are executed; original content and unknown fields are preserved.
fileError: The file or one of its rules could not be processed. Check the IDs, expressions and import report.
inspectionOnly: Diagnostic codes identify unsupported rules, unresolved parameters, duplicates, equation mismatches and commands that are never executed. Device deployment requires a separate reviewed operation.
invalidExpression: Enter a valid expression with integer values and numeric parameter references. Group mixed operators with parentheses.
readHint: Read the device to obtain its current settings. Opening this page only loads saved results.
parametersNotRead: A complete parameter response has not been received for this device.
rulesNotRead: Device rules have not been read yet. Local drafts do not describe the device configuration.
confirmedEmptyParameters: The complete device response contains no parameters.
confirmedEmptyRules: The complete device response contains no rules.
localParameterHint: No configured parameter names are available. Advanced editing uses explicit parameter IDs; device dependencies are checked before sending.
complexExpressionHint: This expression uses advanced syntax. Edit its text without flattening its structure.
replacingRule: This ID already exists on the device. Sending will replace that one rule.
reportWhenTrue: Report when the condition becomes true
reportWhenFalse: Report when the condition becomes false
positiveEventHint: 1–65535. Use an event code established for this device; allocation is not automatic.
reportingRequired: Enable at least one transition and enter a positive event code for each enabled report.
calculationOnlyHint: Both event codes are zero. This rule does not send a report when its condition changes.
transitionDisabled: This transition will not send a report.
rulesContinuationHint: Parameters have been read. Read the rules to complete this configuration read.
readingParameters: Step 1 of 2: reading parameters. Rules will be read after the complete response.
chooseBranch: Choose a fleet from the Branch menu above to read or change settings. Local drafts remain available.
measurementConfirmationHint: This time confirms the configuration readback. Received measurements are shown separately.
measurementChangeAt: This parameter change was confirmed at
noMeasurementsAfterChange: The received records for this period contain no values after the change was confirmed.
measurementDeltaHint: Up to 4 unique messages are shown in UTC time order. Differences are between received records; they alone do not confirm periodic reporting. Values are shown as supplied by Karma.
measurementsEmpty: No received records for this period
measurementsEmptyHint: This result does not determine whether the device is online or the ignition is on.
measurementsError: Measurements could not be read. Try again.
